input.summary: Delete the customer-payable liquidated damages for late payment and replace with simple late interest.
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by us; 15% of annual Fees per week for a late invoice is punitive and unenforceable in substance. We have replaced it with customary late-payment interest on undisputed amounts.

ops.oldText: 7.7 If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
ops.newText: 7.7 If an undisputed invoice is not paid within thirty days of its due date, Vendor's sole remedy is interest on the overdue amount at the lesser of one percent per month and the maximum rate permitted by Applicable Law. Customer is not liable for liquidated damages or penalties.
